pot_bay_wall.source: user: curved rear wall about 0.5 cm from pot, partially wraps rear of pot, chamfered edges; CoffeeMachine 113/114 photos; user correction: right tray rear wall is flush with chamfer ends
pot_bay_wall.geometry: inner cylindrical radius = pot belly radius + 5 mm; 140 degree rear wrap including outward 6 mm edge chamfers; right tray rear wall coplanar with chamfer endpoints, with no recessed transition
pot_bay_wall.estimated_dimensions: 140 degree wrap and 6 mm chamfers are adjustable photo-based assumptions; shoulder/neck clearances are larger than the belly clearance
pot_bay_wall.tray_wall_alignment_status: user_confirmed_flush_relation; tray rear edge and slot decoration trimmed to meet the same wall plane

cup_friction.source: operator proposal 2026-10-29: cup/cup lower than cup/rack
cup_friction.selection: 0.05 is an unmeasured low-friction development assumption; 0.2 self-locks nested rigid tapered cups in the force bench. Must measure or randomize before transfer.

rack_contact_shape.source: operator confirms four plastic tabs that elastically bend under pull and catch each cup rim
rack_contact_shape.model: four independent passive torsional-flexure equivalents; not literal metal hinges or FEM plastic sheets
rack_contact_shape.nominal_stiffness_basis: 0.007 N m/rad per tab is an unmeasured equivalent-flexure prior; assess complete pull force in the bench against the approved two-full-cup water-weight reference, not stiffness alone. Damping 0.00015 N m s/rad includes coupled cup load, not just bare tab inertia.

hotplate.source: 2026-10-29 native four-camera RGB-D pot-removed captures; dark opaque disk contour projected onto table-parallel plane 45 mm above tabletop
hotplate.uncertainty_applies_to: diameter; engineering bound, not statistical confidence interval
hotplate.scope: black heating disk, not the entire white pot support platform
hotplate.limitations: assumes table-parallel disk at 45 mm; repeat frames share calibration; camera scale and contour selection remain uncertain

machine_width.source: operator ruler measurement supplied 2026-10-29: maximum left-to-right outer housing width 31.5 cm
machine_width.scope: machine.size_m[1], maximum outer width along table Y; depth and height remain photo estimates
machine_width.model_application: preserve machine center and pot-bay offsets; move each outer side inward 2.5 mm
machine_width.camera_comparison: annotated front reference widths: head 297.5 mm, chest 300.7 mm, left wrist 312.3 mm; not identical landmarks to maximum housing width, so no camera scale correction inferred

cup_rolled_rim.source: operator confirms lip engagement; 70 mm overall rim diameter preserved
